name: HAPPY SAIN† SHEOL ~Mouja Shoujo Maya~
original_name: HAPPY SAIN† SHEOL ～亡者少女マヤ～
source:
Two thousand years ago, a disaster swept through the land, corrupting all living things and making it too difficult to live. For those that still wish to live on this dead land, a temple was established. It was known as Saint Sheol.

I am a maiden who is ashamed of the flowers of this depressing world.
I was thinking about the person I was secretly in love with, and died in an unfortunate accident.
Oh, how pitiful I was... then, a pitch black devil appeared in front of me!
I'm now back from the dead, and I'm supposed to use my "dead girl" powers to bring down the men of the temple? With a "homemade pie"??

—"What are you talking about......?"

[Translated from the [url=https://hsshmaya.122pxsheol.com/]official website[/url]]
translation:
两千多年前，一场灾难席卷大地，腐蚀了万物生灵，难以生存。为了那些仍然希望在这片死寂的土地上生活的人，建立了一座寺庙。它被称为圣阴间。

我是一个对这压抑的世界的花朵感到羞耻的少女。
我想着那个我暗恋的人，却在一次不幸的事故中去世了。
唉，我真是可怜啊……然后，一个漆黑的恶魔出现在了我的面前！
我现在死而复生了，我应该用我的“死女孩”力量来打倒圣殿的人吗？与“自制馅饼”？

-“你在说什么……？”

[翻译自[url=https://hsshmaya.122pxsheol.com/]官网[/url]]
